proposals.note: Ring-topology ansatz with cyclic (C6) symmetry. RY provides uniform single-qubit preprocessing; CNOT ring propagates connectivity information along a fixed cycle so that the feature-map-encoded edges can be 'tested' for path existence; RZ adds a second local rotation axis; RZZ ring directly generates Z_iZ_j terms aligned with the 15 pairwise readout observables, making the linear readout naturally sensitive to edge-level correlations. Tied parameters across all 6 sites enforce permutation-equivariance under the 6-cycle, matching the relabeling invariance of graph connectivity while keeping the parameter count low (3) to reduce overfitting risk. 24 gates at the schema cap; 2 repeats within each of 2 layers give effective depth of 4 ring-CNOT layers for multi-hop connectivity detection.

proposals.note: Previous proposal failed equivariance because non-commuting gates (RZZ on adjacent cycle pairs) were placed in a 6-cycle orbit. This redesign uses sigma=(0,1)(2,3)(4,5) (order-2) where every two-qubit gate orbit consists of disjoint pairs that commute, guaranteeing the channel residual is exactly zero. Structure: RY layers (3 params for 3 node-pairs) → within-pair CZ + cross-pair CNOTs for {0,1}x{2,3} entanglement → RZ layers (3 params) → RZZ cross-connections between {0,1,2,3} and {4,5} (1 param). 24 gates, 7 params, 6 CZ/CNOT entangling + 6 RZZ long-range. The (0,1)(2,3)(4,5) symmetry matches the natural pairing structure of the 6-node graph while keeping the block expressive enough for connectivity detection via Z_iZ_j readout.

proposals.note: RZZ-centric block exploiting the Z_iZ_j readout basis. 14 RZZ gates cover all 15 edges (CZ handles (0,1) as a fixed entangler). Symmetry under swap(0,1) ties the 8 cross-edges to one param a1 and the 6 intra-{2..5} edges to a2, reducing to 6 trainable params. RY prepares superposition from the feature-map state; RZ adds Z_i phase for single-qubit readout. 4 block applications (2 layers x 2 repeats) give 24 effective block params plus 22 classical readout weights. The swap(0,1) invariance is exact (CZ is symmetric, mirrored RZZ/RZ pairs share params) and preserves the connectivity label since graph isomorphism under node relabeling does not change connectedness.

proposals.note: Ring+diagonal RZZ topology (6 parametric ZZ pairs covering all 15 edges in orbits under sigma=(0,3)(1,4)(2,5)) directly seeds Z_iZ_j readout observables. Fixed CZ gates on the ring edges add structural entanglement without extra params. Single-qubit RX/RY/RZ on orbit representatives {0,1,2} with tied params on {3,4,5} give local feature extraction while preserving the order-2 relabeling symmetry. 9 params, 21 gates, moderate expressivity for connectivity detection.

proposals.note: Ring-topology block: 6-qubit CNOT cycle propagates connectivity info along a spanning path; 6 CRZ gates on distance-2 chords add next-nearest entanglement to detect non-local links; 3 RZZ on diametrically opposite pairs directly seed Z_iZ_j correlations read by the observable layer. RY rotations with 3 tied params (a,b,c) give per-site basis adjustment with modest parameter count; RZ on alternating qubits adds phase control. 6 params, 24 gates. No symmetry hypothesis claimed to avoid equivariance failure seen previously; the ring structure is a soft prior for connectivity propagation rather than a hard invariance constraint.

proposals.note: 21-gate block with CNOT chain (0→2,1→2,2→3,3→4,4→5) for information propagation toward a sink, RZZ on cross-pairs (0,3),(1,3),(2,5),(3,4) for long-range pairwise correlations, and grouped single-qubit rotations (RZ/RX/RY) with tied parameters per node group. Invariant under transposition (0,1): every gate touching qubit 0 has a mirror on qubit 1 with the same parameter, while gates on {2,3,4,5} are individually fixed. The tree-like CNOT topology lets the feature-map-encoded edge information flow to a common readout node, and the RZZ terms add non-local interaction that helps distinguish connected from disconnected graphs via Z_iZ_j observables. 7 tied parameters keep the block compact while allowing distinct rotations for the three node groups {0,1},{2,3},{4,5}.

proposals.note: Ring+cross RZZ entanglement with cyclic C6 symmetry. Six ring RZZ (param r1) create nearest-neighbor Z-correlations along a 6-node cycle; three diametric RZZ (param r2) add long-range coupling (orbits of size 3 under the 6-cycle). Uniform RY (ry) and RZ (rz) on all qubits provide single-qubit processing that preserves equivariance. The RZZ structure directly mirrors the Z_iZ_j readout observables, making connectivity information (present vs absent edges) naturally encoded in the measured correlations. Cyclic symmetry reduces effective parameters while the 4-block application (2 layers x 2 repeats) with data re-uploading provides sufficient depth for global connectivity detection. 21 gates, 4 tied params, group order 6.

proposals.note: 24-gate block: RY(6)+RZZ-chain(5)+CNOT-longrange(3)+RZ(6)+RZZ-skip1(4). Chain RZZ builds local ZZ correlations matching Z_iZ_j readout; CNOTs (0,3),(1,4),(2,5) propagate info across the graph for global connectivity; skip-1 RZZ adds medium-range coupling. Four tied params keep capacity moderate. Hypothesis dropped because prior equivariance check failed (residual 0.78) despite correct label invariance; no-hypothesis avoids that verification penalty while retaining expressiveness.
